subproblem.title: Existence and upper semicontinuity of the density from uniformly almost-monotone density ratios
subproblem.statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, V a rectifiable n-varifold in E = ℝ^{n+ℓ} whose weight μ = μ_V is finite on compact sets, and U ⊆ E any set. For η ∈ E and ρ > 0 write a_η(ρ) := μ(B_ρ(η))/ρⁿ (closed balls, real-valued measure). Suppose that for every ξ ∈ U there exist r > 0 and c: ℝ → ℝ with c(ρ) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0 such that for every η with |η − ξ| < r there are F, E: ℝ → ℝ with e^{−c(ρ)} ≤ F(ρ) ≤ e^{c(ρ)} and |E(ρ)| ≤ c(ρ) for all ρ ∈ (0, r), and with ρ ↦ F(ρ)a_η(ρ) + E(ρ) nondecreasing on (0, r). Then for every ξ ∈ U the quotient μ(B_ρ(ξ))/(ω_nρⁿ) converges to V.density ξ as ρ ↓ 0 (V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ)), and V.density is upper semicontinuous on U.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → (∀ ξ ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∃ c : ℝ → ℝ, Tendsto c (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ η ∈ ball ξ r, ∃ F E : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 r, F ρ ∈ Icc (Real.exp (-c ρ)) (Real.exp (c ρ)) ∧ |E ρ| ≤ c ρ) ∧ MonotoneOn (fun ρ ↦ F ρ * (V.weight.real (closedBall η ρ) / ρ ^ n) + E ρ) (Ioo 0 r)) → (∀ ξ ∈ U, V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ)) ∧ UpperSemicontinuousOn V.density U
subproblem.natural_proof:
This lemma isolates the density argument shared by the parent proof's Step 3 (remark after 3.17: 'ρ ↦ F(ρ)a(ρ) is nondecreasing ... so it has a limit L; since F(ρ) → 1, a(ρ) → L ... upper semicontinuity ... continuity from above') and Step 6 (4.9: 'Ψ = Fa + F − 1 is nondecreasing ... Ψ(ρ) → L; since F(ρ) → 1, a(ρ) → L ... uniform Λ near ξ ... continuity from above').
0. Preliminaries. ω := ω_n = omega n > 0: the open unit ball of ℝⁿ is nonempty and open, so its Lebesgue measure is positive, and bounded, so finite; ω is that measure. For η ∈ E and ρ > 0, B_ρ(η) is compact, so μ(B_ρ(η)) < ∞, a_η(ρ) ≥ 0, and μ(B_ρ(η))/(ωρⁿ) = a_η(ρ)/ω.
1. Key claim. Let ξ ∈ U with data r, c as in the hypothesis, let |η − ξ| < r, and let F, E be the functions provided for η; put Ψ(ρ) := F(ρ)a_η(ρ) + E(ρ) for ρ ∈ (0, r). Then: (a) L_η := lim_{ρ↓0}Ψ(ρ) exists in ℝ and L_η ≤ Ψ(ρ) for every ρ ∈ (0, r); (b) a_η(ρ) → L_η as ρ ↓ 0; (c) V.HasDensityAt η (V.density η) and ω·V.density η = L_η; (d) ω·V.density η ≤ e^{c(ρ)}a_η(ρ) + c(ρ) for every ρ ∈ (0, r).
Proof of (a): on (0, r), c(ρ) ≥ |E(ρ)| ≥ 0. Since c(ρ) → 0, fix ρ₀ ∈ (0, r) with c ≤ 1 on (0, ρ₀]. For ρ ∈ (0, ρ₀], Ψ(ρ) ≥ E(ρ) ≥ −c(ρ) ≥ −1 because F(ρ) ≥ e^{−c(ρ)} > 0 and a_η(ρ) ≥ 0; for ρ ∈ [ρ₀, r), Ψ(ρ) ≥ Ψ(ρ₀) ≥ −1 by monotonicity. A nondecreasing function on (0, r) that is bounded below converges as ρ ↓ 0 to its infimum L_η := inf_{(0,r)}Ψ ∈ [−1, ∞), and L_η ≤ Ψ(ρ) for all ρ ∈ (0, r).
Proof of (b): e^{−c(ρ)} ≤ F(ρ) ≤ e^{c(ρ)} and c(ρ) → 0 give F(ρ) → e⁰ = 1 by squeezing and continuity of exp; |E(ρ)| ≤ c(ρ) gives E(ρ) → 0. As F(ρ) > 0, a_η(ρ) = (Ψ(ρ) − E(ρ))/F(ρ) → (L_η − 0)/1 = L_η.
Proof of (c): by 0 and (b), μ(B_ρ(η))/(ωρⁿ) = a_η(ρ)/ω → L_η/ω as ρ ↓ 0, i.e. V.HasDensityAt η (L_η/ω). The filter of right neighbourhoods of 0 in (0, ∞) is nontrivial and ℝ is Hausdorff, so V.density η, defined as the limUnder of this quotient along that filter, equals L_η/ω. Hence V.HasDensityAt η (V.density η) and ω·V.density η = L_η.
Proof of (d): for ρ ∈ (0, r), L_η ≤ Ψ(ρ) = F(ρ)a_η(ρ) + E(ρ) ≤ e^{c(ρ)}a_η(ρ) + c(ρ), using F(ρ) ≤ e^{c(ρ)}, a_η(ρ) ≥ 0 and E(ρ) ≤ |E(ρ)| ≤ c(ρ).
2. Existence. For ξ ∈ U apply 1(c) with η := ξ (|ξ − ξ| = 0 < r). So V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ) for every ξ ∈ U.
3. Upper semicontinuity. Fix ξ ∈ U with data r, c, and t > V.density ξ. By 1(b),(c) with η = ξ, a_ξ(ρ) → ω·V.density ξ, hence e^{c(ρ)}a_ξ(ρ) + c(ρ) → ω·V.density ξ < ωt as ρ ↓ 0; choose ρ ∈ (0, r) with e^{c(ρ)}a_ξ(ρ) + c(ρ) < ωt. The closed balls B_{ρ+δ}(ξ) decrease as δ ↓ 0 with intersection B_ρ(ξ) and μ(B_{ρ+1}(ξ)) < ∞, so by continuity of measure from above μ(B_{ρ+δ}(ξ)) → μ(B_ρ(ξ)) as δ ↓ 0; since e^{c(ρ)}/ρⁿ > 0, choose δ ∈ (0, r) with e^{c(ρ)}μ(B_{ρ+δ}(ξ))/ρⁿ + c(ρ) < ωt. Let |η − ξ| < δ. Then |η − ξ| < r and B_ρ(η) ⊆ B_{ρ+δ}(ξ) (triangle inequality), so a_η(ρ) ≤ μ(B_{ρ+δ}(ξ))/ρⁿ (monotonicity of the finite measure μ). By 1(d) for this η (with the data of ξ and ρ ∈ (0, r)): ω·V.density η ≤ e^{c(ρ)}a_η(ρ) + c(ρ) ≤ e^{c(ρ)}μ(B_{ρ+δ}(ξ))/ρⁿ + c(ρ) < ωt, hence V.density η < t. Thus V.density < t on the neighbourhood {|η − ξ| < δ} of ξ, in particular on a neighbourhood of ξ relative to U; this is upper semicontinuity of V.density within U at ξ. As ξ ∈ U was arbitrary, V.density is upper semicontinuous on U. ∎
proof_key_steps: Ψ = F·a_η + E is nondecreasing and ≥ −1 on (0, r), so Ψ(ρ) → L_η = inf Ψ and L_η ≤ Ψ(ρ)
F → 1 and E → 0 give a_η → L_η; limUnder gives ω_n·V.density η = L_η and V.HasDensityAt η (V.density η)
Bound ω_n·V.density η ≤ e^{c(ρ)}a_η(ρ) + c(ρ) for |η − ξ| < r, 0 < ρ < r
u.s.c.: pick ρ with e^{c(ρ)}a_ξ(ρ) + c(ρ) < ω_n t, then δ by continuity from above of μ(B_{ρ+δ}(ξ)); B_ρ(η) ⊆ B_{ρ+δ}(ξ) gives V.density η < t for |η − ξ| < δ

audit.reason: The proof supplies a lower bound for the monotone corrected ratios, obtains a finite real limit, and identifies density through limUnder. Uniform nearby-centre bounds and continuity from above establish upper semicontinuity. Neither openness of U nor positive n is needed for this general statement.
